acceptance_assertion_note: Each row names its exact executable check; manual-review kind only where governance-only.
note: FLEET contract extension to the staged-read baseline. Component-tested means CPU fixtures through PrismaBuild, not deployed fleet or campaign qualification. Runtime deployment and actual native/container worker join/resign remain unqualified until separately recorded. Unknown remains owed work. Uses the existing roster, broker maintenance gate, queue claim/withdrawal/retry and worker reaper.

requirements.text: Registered boxes place by class-tag conjunction; more gb10 workers need no host listing.
CPU-only x86 vs ARM+CUDA distinguished by class conjunction and has_gpu; no cross-admission.

requirements.enforcement: box_capacity GPU_MEMORY_DOMAINS; mem_gb vs VRAM budgets separate
requirements.text: Discrete (wsl-gpu) vs unified (GB10) memory domains recorded separately; VRAM never inflates host RAM.

requirements.enforcement: _matching_offers returns no match; unknown kinds are unknown, never zero
requirements.text: Unknown backend explicitly unsupported; no fake memory/GPU advertised.

requirements.enforcement: offers(max_age_s=120); placeable None when nobody has said
requirements.text: Missing/stale offers read as unavailable, never as zero capacity; heartbeats never release tokens.

requirements.acceptance: manual-review: roster status active with provenance before join
requirements.text: Desired membership is the declaration (active vs retired/offline with reason/by/unix); restart never auto-rejoins an absent box.

requirements.acceptance: tests/test_fleet_membership_join_resign.py::test_join_refuses_absent_roster + test_join_refuses_unhealthy_broker; tests/test_membership_published_entrypoint.py verifies command publication and both immutable runtime layouts
requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.join validates roster + broker health + storage before touching the gate
requirements.text: Join validates runtime/broker/capacity/telemetry/storage before eligibility; any failure leaves the gate as-is.
Drain gate fail-closed; changed_unix names the epoch; reason is descriptive only.

requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.resign: begin, exact-loop park acks, withdraw owned claims
requirements.text: Resign stops new claims at begin, waits exact-loop acks for that changed_unix, withdraws owned claims via the ladder; stale epochs never ack.

requirements.enforcement: no gate/broker/queue mutation on refusal paths
requirements.text: Voluntary resign distinct from crash/expiry; heartbeat disappearance alone releases nothing; failed containment stays resigning with reason.

requirements.acceptance: tests/test_fleet_membership_busy_resign.py chained-resign and uninterruptible-natural-terminal cases; tests/test_fullstack_reader_boundaries.py and test_reader_refs_holder_unknown.py cover the accepted reader SDK component integration. Live containment remains separately owed.
requirements.enforcement: PoolQueue.plan_requeue/publish withdrawal lineage plus fleet_membership.resign; broker and reader containment remain authoritative.
requirements.text: Owned scopes must be contained before release. Retry-safe work yields through the withdrawal ladder and requeues with preserved attempt budgets; retry-unsafe or budget-exhausted work drains to its natural terminal under graceful resign.

requirements.acceptance: manual-review: joining host opens only its gate; frozen child scopes immutable
requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.join, worker_loop admission_open callback, PoolQueue.claim/_claim/serve_once, broker maintenance epoch CAS.
requirements.text: Joining a qualified worker opens only its own gate; frozen child scopes and other workers remain unchanged. Claim checks the local admission gate under the existing per-key transition lock, with broker scope-create refusal as backstop.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: Absent leases namespace drains; present-but-unenumerable pins retain with reason.
requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.reader_refs_gate in the resign completion chain
requirements.text: Resign reports resigned only with reader refs drained as well as scopes/claims; attestation writing and reclaim are the lease worker's automatic path, consumed here as proof.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: Withdraw-then-crash resumes with one exact linked successor; ordinary cancellations never revive; an old claimed-generation handoff never retargets a newer READY successor.
requirements.enforcement: fleet_membership.resume_owed + exact-linkage adopt in the resign rounds
requirements.text: Resign handoff intent survives resigner crash via authoritative withdrawn decisions; new supervisors adopt only provably-gone owners' rows with exact successor lineage, never double-publish, never clobber newer publications.

requirements.acceptance_assertion: Malformed/stale counters never match; uninterruptible rows drain naturally with no withdrawal record.
requirements.text: Exact-attempt terminals require fully typed identity plus the exact transition counter; graceful resign retains retry-unsafe/budget-exhausted work to its natural terminal and never cancels it.
